title: Show picture of the day metadata on the desktop
line: The Picture of the Day wallpaper can now show the picture's title and author on the desktop.
explanation: The Picture of the Day wallpaper only showed the picture's title and author inside its settings page, so there was no way to see what today's picture is from the desktop. The open MR plasma-workspace!6852 only turns the preview banner into a general branding banner and doesn't show any picture details. The change adds a "Show title and author on the desktop" option (off by default) to the wallpaper settings; when it's on, the wallpaper draws the title and author in the bottom-left corner with the same shadowed labels as the preview banner, placed with the containment's available screen region so panels never cover it.

commits.message:
wallpapers/potd: optionally show the title and author on the desktop

The picture's title and author were only visible in the wallpaper
settings. Add an option to show them in the bottom-left corner of the
desktop, styled like the preview banner and kept clear of panels.

BUG: 483835

patches.diff:
From 21251ad8a09f71a95abc17002c94da9bf82ea41b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 20:43:06 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wallpapers/potd: optionally show the title and author on the
 desktop

The picture's title and author were only visible in the wallpaper
settings. Add an option to show them in the bottom-left corner of the
desktop, styled like the preview banner and kept clear of panels.

BUG: 483835
---
 .../potd/package/contents/config/main.xml     |  4 +++
 .../potd/package/contents/ui/config.qml       |  6 ++++
 wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml  | 33 +++++++++++++++++++
 3 files changed, 43 insertions(+)

diff --git a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml
index a66b98e5c..d4a756966 100644
--- a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml
+++ b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/config/main.xml
@@ -22,6 +22,10 @@
       <label>Update wallpaper over metered connection. 0 - False, 1 - True, 2 - True when data usage is below limit (not implemented)</label>
       <default>0</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="ShowInfo" type="Bool">
+      <label>Show the title and author of the picture on the desktop</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
   </group>
 
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/config.qml b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/config.qml
index 0975d106e..cd0ba9d44 100644
--- a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/config.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/config.qml
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
     property int cfg_FillMode
     property alias cfg_Color: colorButton.color
     property int cfg_UpdateOverMeteredConnection
+    property alias cfg_ShowInfo: showInfoCheckBox.checked
     property alias formLayout: root
 
     readonly property size screenSize: Qt.size(Screen.width, Screen.height)
@@ -136,6 +137,11 @@ Kirigami.FormLayout {
         }
     }
 
+    QQC2.CheckBox {
+        id: showInfoCheckBox
+        text: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.potd", "@option:check", "Show title and author on the desktop")
+    }
+
     Kirigami.Separator {
         id: previewSeparator
         Kirigami.FormData.isSection: true
diff --git a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml
index b179ce7e6..ba25d5fc0 100644
--- a/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/potd/package/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
 import QtQuick.Window
 
 import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
+import org.kde.plasma.extras as PlasmaExtras
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 
 import org.kde.plasma.wallpapers.potd
@@ -145,4 +146,36 @@ WallpaperItem {
             }
         }
     }
+
+    Loader {
+        id: infoLoader
+
+        // On the desktop the parent is the containment, which knows where the panels are
+        readonly property Item containmentItem: root.parent
+        readonly property point pos: containmentItem?.availableScreenRegion, item !== null && typeof containmentItem?.adjustToAvailableScreenRegion === "function"
+            ? containmentItem.adjustToAvailableScreenRegion(
+                0,
+                root.height - item.height - Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing,
+                item.width + Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing,
+                item.height + Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing)
+            : Qt.point(0, root.height - (item?.height ?? 0) - Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing)
+
+        x: pos.x + Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+        y: pos.y
+        active: root.configuration.ShowInfo && (backend.title.length > 0 || backend.author.length > 0)
+
+        sourceComponent: Column {
+            PlasmaExtras.ShadowedLabel {
+                text: backend.title
+                visible: text.length > 0
+                // Emulate the size of a level 1 heading
+                font.pointSize: Math.round(Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pointSize * 1.35)
+            }
+
+            PlasmaExtras.ShadowedLabel {
+                text: backend.author
+                visible: text.length > 0
+            }
+        }
+    }
 }
--
